name: Firefox ESR
description: Mozilla's browser, from Debian. Every site sees only this mini VM's exit: its time zone, its city for location, no local addresses over WebRTC.
changelog: First release: Debian's Firefox ESR, updated by Debian, with telemetry off, fingerprinting protection on, WebRTC limited to the exit's address and location set to the exit's city.
securityNotes: Clipboard for copy and paste, Shared for downloads and uploads, Sound and Microphone for video, music and calls; V2Mac asks before each is first used while it is open. Location is answered from the exit's coordinates (exit.json); WebRTC never offers local addresses.
